Surgery-based LGR, no non-binary marker and limited anti-discrimination follow-through are resident-facing gaps and only climate signals. No evidence of organised targeting, and anti-LGBT bias provisions exist though enforcement is unproven. Society is conservative with concentrated urban visibility — friction, not documented hostility toward trans visitors.
